thread:
Aisha (Marketing PM): ok team, final pass on the launch blog — we need the benchmark methodology blurb + speaker lineup for the webinar in the same doc. can we lock this today?
Marco (Growth): yes. prioritize the benchmarking transparency section and a short CTA for the webinar signup.
Priya (Content): I pushed a new draft to the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/blog-draft — added a 3-paragraph methods section. pls sanity-check numbers.
Sam (Product): quick note: benchmarks are 95th p95 latency vs base-model on standard 2k token gen. call it out as "median payloads"? prefer "typical payloads" for clarity.
Priya (Content): changed to "typical payloads (1–2k tokens)". also added the sample prompt we used.
Marco (Growth): re: webinar — final host list: Aisha + Sam + guest: Dr. Lin (bench author) + UI demo from Nora. need one-liner bios and headshots.
Nora (Ops): have a 5-min demo slot showing dedicated routing + fallback. will prep a short runbook for the demo to avoid flakiness.
Eli (Legal): flagged one claim in benchmarks: "up to 3x cheaper" — need source and a short qualifier. prefer: "up to 3x lower per-token cost in our test workload vs default quantized baseline; see methodology."
Priya (Content): added Eli's qualifier. also added link anchor to a short appendix with the dataset and run commands.
Aisha (Marketing PM): good — Growth wants the HubSpot gating and inbound routing details in the post: which UTM params, what list to append, and webinar CTA mapping. Marco?
Marco (Growth): mapping: utm_campaign=optimize_launch, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. webhook -> HubSpot form id 89234, tag: "optimize_launch_blog". I'll paste the webhook JSON below.
Marco (Growth): ```json
{
  "form_id": 89234,
  "tags": ["optimize_launch_blog", "webinar_signup"],
  "workflow": "send-demo-invite"
}
```
Priya (Content): added that snippet under "How to register" so ops can wire it. can someone confirm the webhook endpoint and SLA?
Nora (Ops): webhook endpoint is https://hooks.redwood.ai/hubspot/ingest — will add retry logic and 2s backoff. SLA for form -> contact create: < 120s.
Eli (Legal): quick on speaker quotes — need written approval for Dr. Lin's quote. Priya, can you ping them for signoff?
Priya (Content): DM'd Dr. Lin, requested a signed quote by EOD. also captured a draft quote: "Redwood's serving optimizations materially reduce tail latency without degrading quality."
Sam (Product): small ask — include an architecture blurb (1 paragraph) about routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> quantized variant) so engineering readers know it won't tank under load.
Aisha (Marketing PM): Priya add that. Also we need publish window: preferred go-live is Tue 09:00 PT to hit APAC later in day. Marco, can you confirm HubSpot campaign schedule?
Marco (Growth): confirmed. I'll queue the nurture emails to go out at +1h and +24h. CTA in email -> webinar registration + benchmark whitepaper.
Nora (Ops): one ops item: please do not schedule demo at same time as heavy infra maintenance next week. I'm blocking maintenance 03/25 02:00-06:00 PT.
Aisha (Marketing PM): noted. Tue 09:00 PT is clear.
Eli (Legal): approving the content with the added qualifiers and quote approval caveat. final sign-off pending Dr. Lin's written ok.
publish-bot: scheduled publish draft created: publish/1718901234-draft (workflow: review_needed).
Aisha (Marketing PM): last checklist: 1) Dr. Lin signed quote 2) Nora demo runbook uploaded 3) HubSpot webhook tested end-to-end 4) final proofread. Everyone ✅?
Sam (Product): runbook uploaded to the doc, demo tested in staging.✅
Marco (Growth): webhook v1 tested, sample contact created.✅
Priya (Content): proofread complete, fixed a couple of awkward sentences.✅
Nora (Ops): will do one dry-run on Mon 11:00 PT and confirm.
Eli (Legal): will confirm quote sign-off when received.
Aisha (Marketing PM): awesome — we'll hold final publish until Dr. Lin signs. if they don't by EOD tomorrow, we swap the quote for a neutral paraphrase. thanks team :rocket:
